value.rules_markdown:
- rustfmt output, Rust 2024 idioms. Use `snake_case` for modules/files, `PascalCase` for types.
- Return `Result<T>` using the crate error type from `src/error.rs`.
- Every file opens with a `//!` module doc describing its role and feature gating.
- Comments explain the *decision*, not the code; say why a flag or ordering is load-bearing.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use `///` to become help text.
- Tests live in-crate: `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` at module bottom, move to sibling file when large.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock; `MockForge` records writes for assertions.
- Lane behaviour is covered by golden tests: fixture diff plus canned structured response.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Keep every Markdown file at 500 lines or fewer; split into focused files when exceeding.
- Commit subjects are concise and imperative; keep commits small and coherent.
- Pull requests state what changed, behaviour change, and how it was verified.
- The default build is offline; network features go behind `harness`, `github`, or `serve`.
- One responsibility per module, core types in a module-local `types.rs`.
- Every port in `src/ports/` is one trait in one file.
- CLI subcommands are declared even if their milestone hasn't landed.
- A preset is a folder with `preset.toml`, `README.md`, and optional prompt overrides.
- Never edit the `vendor/tinyagents` submodule here; change upstream and bump pin.
- Examples in `Cargo.toml` use `required-features` so credential-needing tests never build in CI.
- The model never holds a write token; write credentials minted only in `src/apply/` after all model calls return.
- Contributor code is never executed; we read diff and tree, we do not build or run scripts.
- Pull request bodies, comments, and diffs are untrusted input; fence and label them in prompts.
- Secrets found by scanners are reported by type and location only; value never reaches comment or log.
- Deterministic policy in `src/apply/` and `src/automerge/` may mutate GitHub; model verdict is advisory.
- A lane that leaves a change in the checkout fails.
